nodes.one_liner_zh: FTS5 默认分词器：处理拉丁/数字很好，不切中文词——中文查询只有语义一条腿
nodes.one_liner_en: FTS5's default tokenizer: great for Latin/digits, no CJK word-splitting — CJK queries run on the semantic leg alone
nodes.professional_zh: 词法臂建立在 FTS5 的 unicode61 tokenizer 上（含 M* 类别补丁处理孟加拉/阿拉伯拆词——DigUp A1 教训已继承）。已知缺口：unicode61 不切中文词，整句中文进索引成了长 token，关键词匹配对中文查询基本失效（R10b）。候选方案（二元切分 / trigram）已立项未裁决——任何更改都要 A/B + 指纹影响评估。这是台账上公开的差距，不是藏着的短板。
nodes.professional_en: The lexical arm rides FTS5's unicode61 tokenizer (with the M* category patch for Bengali/Arabic word-splitting — DigUp incident A1's inherited lesson). Known gap: unicode61 doesn't split CJK words; whole Chinese sentences index as long tokens, so keyword matching is mostly dead for CJK queries (R10b). Candidate fixes (bigram / trigram) are proposed but undecided — any change needs A/B plus a fingerprint impact review. This gap is on the public ledger, not hidden.
nodes.plain_zh: 这台切词机认空格和标点，中文没空格它就整句囫囵吞。所以中文搜索全靠语义那条腿——已知、在账上、有候选方案没拍板。
nodes.plain_en: This tokenizer splits on spaces and punctuation; Chinese has none, so it swallows whole sentences. CJK search runs on the semantic leg alone — known, on the ledger, candidates proposed.
nodes.example_zh: search '退款期限' --lexical --db …：中文词法命中弱是现状；--pack（语义+词法融合）不受此限。
nodes.example_en: search '退款期限' --lexical shows the weak CJK lexical hits; hybrid --pack is unaffected.
code_refs: goldmine/lexical_store.py — FTS5 表与 tokenizer DDL
nodes.analogy_zh: 切词机不认中文，中文靠语义腿
nodes.analogy_en: No CJK splitting; semantics carries it

dig_deeper.why_zh: 文本进分词器前的规范化

nodes.one_liner_zh: 查询向量 × 库矩阵 = 一排余弦；fp16 存储 7 万向量约 108MB，查询 +2ms
nodes.one_liner_en: Query vector × library matrix = a row of cosines; fp16 stores ~70k vectors in ~108MB, +2ms per query
nodes.professional_zh: 语义臂的物理形态：全库向量存成矩阵（SQLite BLOB 内 fp16，与行同库防 desync），查询时与查询向量做一次批量余弦。fp16 存储是 DigUp 实测迁移（70k 向量 108MB、查询 +2ms，精度损失在余弦后不可见）。z 分数标准化直接在这个余弦行上算：分模态均值 + 全局 std。mmap 缓存是 DigUp 残余项（Python 侧 malloc 行为不同，10 万+向量级先测再定）。
nodes.professional_en: The semantic arm's physical form: the whole library's vectors live in one matrix (fp16 inside SQLite BLOBs, same database as the rows to prevent desync); each query is one batched cosine pass. fp16 is DigUp's measured migration (70k vectors ≈ 108MB, +2ms per query, precision loss invisible after cosine). z-score standardization runs directly on that cosine row: per-modality mean, global std. mmap caching remains a DigUp leftover (Python's malloc differs; test at 100k+ vectors first).
nodes.plain_zh: 全库的「意思坐标」排成一张大表，每次搜索就是拿你的问题坐标跟整张表比一遍距离——比完再标准化成可比的 z 分。
nodes.plain_en: The whole library's meaning-coordinates in one big table; each search compares your query's coordinates against all of them, then standardizes into comparable z-scores.
nodes.example_zh: tests 里钉着 z=5.0=√(n−1) 的手算矩阵夹具——26 行 1 真 25 填，一行鹤立鸡群 z=√25。
nodes.example_en: A test pins the hand-computed matrix: 26 rows, one true, z=5.0=√(n−1).
nodes.analogy_zh: 全库坐标表 + 一遍批量比距
nodes.analogy_en: One coordinate table, one batched compare

dig_deeper.why_zh: 余弦行怎么变成可比分数
dig_deeper.why_en: How the cosine row becomes comparable scores

nodes.one_liner_zh: 文本嵌入的 HTTP 服务：冷启动被 spawn、用完被杀、查询侧纯文本
nodes.one_liner_en: Text embedding as an HTTP service: spawned cold, killed after, query-side text-only
nodes.professional_zh: 查询与文本嵌入走 llama-server（vendored llama.cpp 的 HTTP 服务形态）：CLI 冷启动时 spawn、close 时按 pid 收殓；查询侧永远是纯文本——图像/音频进不了它的 HTTP 面，这正是媒体边车独立存在的理由。冻结推理参数（ctx 2048/文本 512 等）在 spawn 参数里写死。
nodes.professional_en: Query and text embedding run through llama-server (vendored llama.cpp in its HTTP-server shape): spawned cold by the CLI, reaped by pid at close; the query side is text-only forever — images/audio can't enter its HTTP surface, which is exactly why the media sidecar exists separately. Frozen inference params (ctx 2048 / 512 text) are pinned in the spawn arguments.
nodes.plain_zh: 文本嵌入是请来的短工：来干活时招之即来，干完就走，账本记着它的 pid。它只会处理文字，图片音频归边车管。
nodes.plain_en: Text embedding is hired help: summoned for the job, gone when it ends, pid on the ledger. It handles text only — images and audio belong to the sidecar.
nodes.example_zh: ps 在一次语义 search 期间能看到 llama-server 进程；命令结束后消失。
nodes.example_en: ps during a semantic search shows llama-server; it's gone when the command exits.
code_refs: goldmine/backends/llama.py — spawn 参数与健康管理
nodes.analogy_zh: 招之即来挥之即去的短工

dig_deeper.why_zh: 它走 HTTP 但生命周期靠进程纪律

nodes.one_liner_zh: 1412 行纯 C11 静态链七个库+系统框架——无补丁、无运行时依赖
nodes.one_liner_en: 1,412 lines of plain C11 statically linked to seven libs + system frameworks — no patches, no runtime deps
nodes.professional_zh: 为什么是独立 C 程序而不是给 llama-server 打补丁：mtmd（多模态解码）没有暴露在 llama-server 的 HTTP 面；补丁路线=维护一个永久 fork（升级即地狱）。选择：纯 C11 单文件、cmake 目标加 llama+mtmd → libtool 合并 libllamacpp.a → 静态资产打包并校验（build_native.py）。同样的 recipe 照抄自 DigUp 的 build-llama.sh。产物 1412 行，图片缩放与参考实现逐位一致（黄金表测试）。
nodes.professional_en: Why an independent C program instead of patching llama-server: mtmd (multimodal decode) isn't exposed on llama-server's HTTP surface; the patch route means maintaining a permanent fork (upgrade hell). The choice: one plain C11 file, cmake targets llama+mtmd → libtool-merged libllamacpp.a → packaged static asset with hash verification (build_native.py). The recipe mirrors DigUp's build-llama.sh. The product: 1,412 lines, image resize bit-identical to the reference (golden-table tests).
nodes.plain_zh: 不改装别人的服务器（改装一次，永世维护），自己写个小程序把需要的零件静态焊死——拷到别的机器就能跑。
nodes.plain_en: Rather than fork someone's server forever, write a small program with the needed parts welded in statically — copy it anywhere and it runs.
nodes.example_zh: python3 -m build_native.py 后产物带哈希清单；黄金表测试钉死缩放逐位一致。
nodes.example_en: build_native.py emits a hashed manifest; golden-table tests pin bit-identical resizing.
nodes.analogy_zh: 不改装别人的服务器，自己焊死零件
nodes.analogy_en: Weld your own parts; don't fork theirs

nodes.one_liner_zh: 用 macOS 电源管理接口读 thermal/电池/低电量三态
nodes.one_liner_en: Reads thermal/battery/low-power states from macOS power management
nodes.professional_zh: 电源门控的机械层：pmset（macOS 电源管理 CLI）提供 thermal 受限级别、电源来源、低电量模式三态。watch 以自适应间隔轮询这些信号（不是事件流——电源状态没有回调），把结果映射进门控决策。探针失败按「未知状态」处理：不阻塞、记录原因——探针自己也要遵守诚实降级。
nodes.professional_en: The mechanical layer of power gating: pmset (macOS's power-management CLI) reports thermal pressure level, power source, and low-power mode. watch polls these signals adaptively (not events — power state has no callback stream) and maps them into gating decisions. A failed probe means 'unknown state': no blocking, reason recorded — the probe itself obeys honest degradation.
nodes.plain_zh: 仪表盘读数器：隔一会儿看一眼电脑「发不发烧、插没插电、省电模式开没开」。读不了表就当没读，照常干活但记一笔。
nodes.plain_en: A gauge reader: periodically checks whether the machine is hot, plugged in, or in low-power mode. Can't read the gauge? Note it and carry on.
nodes.example_zh: pmset -g thermlog 或 watch 心跳输出里能看到探测到的三态。
nodes.example_en: pmset -g thermlog or the watch heartbeat shows the probed states.
nodes.analogy_zh: 隔窗读仪表，读不了就记录
nodes.analogy_en: Read the gauge through the window; log it if you can't

dig_deeper.why_en: A sibling in reading system state

nodes.one_liner_zh: scripts/eval_real.py：装载冻结考卷、跑查询、算指标、裁决 --gate
nodes.one_liner_en: scripts/eval_real.py: loads the frozen exam, runs queries, computes metrics, adjudicates --gate
nodes.professional_zh: 评测的执行机：按 --suite（legacy 109 题 / full-media 128 题 / 产品 420 题）装载冻结语料与基线，跑完每道查询，计算 s@5/MRR/nDCG/zero-hit 等指标，与基线做逐指标对比，最后按预注册阈值裁决 gate: green/red。基线身份校验（corpus_version+sha）在装载时执行——考卷不对直接罢工。这是「改坏了立刻知道」的自动化本体。
nodes.professional_en: The machine that executes evaluation: loads frozen corpus and baselines per --suite (legacy 109 / full-media 128 / product 420), runs every query, computes s@5/MRR/nDCG/zero-hit etc., diffs each metric against the baseline, and adjudicates gate: green/red against preregistered thresholds. Baseline identity (corpus_version+sha) is checked at load — wrong exam, immediate strike. This is the automation behind 'you know immediately when something breaks'.
nodes.plain_zh: 自动监考官：发卷、收卷、按标准答案打分、跟上次成绩单对比、宣布过/不过。卷子不对它直接拒绝开考。
nodes.plain_en: The automated proctor: hands out papers, collects, grades against the answer key, diffs the last report card, declares pass/fail. Wrong exam? It refuses to start.
nodes.example_zh: python3 scripts/eval_real.py --suite legacy --backend llama --gate 结尾的 gate: green 是它的裁决输出（ANCHORS 第 4 条）。
nodes.example_en: The trailing 'gate: green' from scripts/eval_real.py --suite legacy --gate is its verdict (ANCHORS #4).
code_refs: scripts/eval_real.py — 套件装载与 gate 裁决
nodes.analogy_zh: 自动监考+对上张成绩单
nodes.analogy_en: Auto-proctor with last term's report card

nodes.one_liner_zh: 长文切成约 450 token 的块——检索与证据的原子单位
nodes.one_liner_en: Long text splits into ~450-token chunks — the atomic unit of retrieval and evidence
nodes.professional_zh: 块是检索的原子：嵌入按块算、命中按块报、证据窗按块选、邻块展开按块邻接。约 450 token（一段半）是「指路」与「自含」的折中。分块规则进指纹/身份体系：chunker 变更使存量行 chunker_stale，下次摄取重切。块切得不好（答案跨块）由邻块展开与证据窗仲裁兜底。
nodes.professional_en: Chunks are retrieval's atoms: embeddings are per-chunk, hits report chunks, evidence windows select chunks, neighbor expansion walks chunk adjacency. ~450 tokens (about a paragraph and a half) balances 'a pointer' against 'self-contained'. Chunking rules live inside the identity system: a chunker change marks stored rows chunker_stale for re-chunking on next ingest. Bad cuts (answers straddling chunks) are papered over by neighbor expansion and window arbitration.
nodes.plain_zh: 书撕成页，页撕成段——每段约一段半正文。答案恰好被切在两段之间是常态，所以才有「带前后邻居」的补救。
nodes.plain_en: Books tear into pages, pages into paragraphs — each chunk about 1.5 paragraphs. Answers straddling cuts are normal, hence the bring-the-neighbors fix.
nodes.example_zh: render 输出里每条命中的位置标记就是块坐标；--context 1 直接演示块邻接。
nodes.example_en: Each hit's location marker in render output is a chunk coordinate; --context 1 demonstrates adjacency directly.
nodes.analogy_zh: 检索原子：约一段半一段

nodes.one_liner_zh: 缺席的请求计入分母、贡献零分——下界口径，不许悄悄缩小分母
nodes.one_liner_en: Missing requests stay in the denominator and score zero — a lower-bound rule; no silent denominator shrinkage
nodes.professional_zh: 评测口径的诚实条款：某次请求失败/超时/解析失败，不能把它从分母里拿掉——它计入固定分母并贡献零分，产出「下界」聚合。对比框架里未知 URI 的命中同样计入分母并判零。反口径（只算成功的）是评测界最常见的自欺：分数随事故率波动而不是随质量波动。
nodes.professional_en: The honesty clause of eval arithmetic: a request that fails/times-out/fails-to-parse may not leave the denominator — it stays counted and scores zero, yielding lower-bound aggregates. Unknown-URI hits in the comparison framework likewise count and score zero. The opposite bookkeeping (count only successes) is eval's most common self-deception: scores that track incident rate, not quality.
nodes.plain_zh: 缺考按零分算，不许「缺席的不算」。分数才有下限的意义。
nodes.plain_en: Absentees score zero; 'absentees don't count' is banned. That's what makes a score mean anything.
nodes.example_zh: COMPARISON.md 里 QMD 的 1/22 就是固定分母口径——失败的请求没有从 n=22 里消失。
nodes.example_en: QMD's 1/22 in COMPARISON.md is fixed-denominator accounting — failed requests never left n=22.

dig_deeper.why_zh: 分母出现在哪些尺子里

nodes.one_liner_zh: 同一道题两版成绩差做重抽样——不显著就回滚
nodes.one_liner_en: Resample per-question deltas between two versions — insignificant means rollback
nodes.professional_zh: 与 McNemar 并用的显著性机器：对每道题的指标差值做 bootstrap 重抽样，得到差值置信区间。选成对设计是因为题目难度方差远大于改动效应——不配对的话信号全被「有的题本来就难」淹没。判定纪律：区间含零 = 不可采纳也不可宣称退化；这是回归门的两台裁判之一。
nodes.professional_en: The significance machinery alongside McNemar: bootstrap-resample the per-question metric deltas to get a confidence interval on the change. Paired by question because question-difficulty variance dwarfs change effects — unpaired, the signal drowns in 'some questions are just hard'. Verdict discipline: an interval spanning zero means neither adopt nor claim regression; it's one of the regression gate's two referees.
nodes.plain_zh: 同一批学生前后两次考试，只看每人涨了多少分，再随机重排无数次看「纯靠运气能不能涨这么多」。运气解释不了才许说有效。
nodes.plain_en: Same students, two exams: look only at each person's delta, then reshuffle at random thousands of times. Only if luck can't explain the gain may you claim the change worked.
nodes.example_zh: 回归门的输出里每项指标带区间；「区间含零」在 FEATURE_STATUS 的 current005 对照里逐项可见。
nodes.example_en: Every gate metric ships with an interval; FEATURE_STATUS's current005 comparison shows zero-spanning cases metric by metric.
nodes.analogy_zh: 重排无数次，运气解释不了才算数
nodes.analogy_en: Reshuffle until luck is ruled out

dig_deeper.why_zh: 区间与 p 值的底层

nodes.one_liner_zh: 同样输入重跑一万次结果一样——Ctrl-C 安全、SIGKILL 重启零重复工作
nodes.one_liner_en: Rerun a thousand times, same result — Ctrl-C safe, SIGKILL restart re-does zero work
nodes.professional_zh: 幂等是摄取管线的设计性质：内容 sha256 跳过使「重跑」几乎零成本（没变的文件直接略过）；一文件一事务使中断最坏丢一个文件的这一次；watch crash-only 设计实测 SIGKILL 重启零重复工作。幂等的价值是把「失败」从需要善后的事故降级为「再跑一遍就行」的普通事件——这是敢自动重试、敢断电续跑的底气。
nodes.professional_en: Idempotency is a designed property of the ingest pipeline: content-sha256 skipping makes reruns nearly free (unchanged files pass through); one transaction per file caps an interrupt's loss at a single file's pass; watch's crash-only design measured zero duplicated work after SIGKILL. Idempotency demotes 'failure' from an incident needing cleanup to a mundane 'run it again' — the confidence behind auto-retry and power-loss resume.
nodes.plain_zh: 断电重开后接着干、绝不重做已完成的活——这不是运气，是「做过的活有收条、收条在就跳过」的设计。
nodes.plain_en: Power loss resumes with zero duplicated work — not luck, but design: completed work leaves receipts, receipts mean skip.
nodes.example_zh: ingest 大目录中途 Ctrl-C 再重跑：第二遍日志里绝大多数文件是 skipped。
nodes.example_en: Ctrl-C a large ingest, rerun: the second log is mostly 'skipped'.
nodes.analogy_zh: 做过的活有收条，收条在就跳过
nodes.analogy_en: Receipts mean done; done means skip

dig_deeper.why_zh: 跳过机制所在的主流程
dig_deeper.why_en: The main flow hosting the skip

nodes.one_liner_zh: 进程手里的「取号牌」：0/1/2 是 stdin/stdout/stderr
nodes.one_liner_en: A process's ticket numbers: 0/1/2 are stdin/stdout/stderr
nodes.professional_zh: Unix 进程通过小整数句柄引用打开的东西：0/1/2 固定是标准输入/输出/错误，其余按需分配。边车纪律②（裸 fd + os.read）正是绕开语言运行库的缓冲层、直接对句柄轮询——因为 BufferedReader 的预读会把管道数据吃进自己的缓冲区，level-triggered poll 永远等不到数据就绪。理解 fd 是理解「为什么 poll 醒不来」这类竞态的前提。
nodes.professional_en: Unix processes reference open things by small integers: 0/1/2 are stdin/stdout/stderr, more allocated on demand. Sidecar rule 2 (raw fd + os.read) exists to bypass the language runtime's buffering and poll the handle directly — BufferedReader's lookahead swallows pipe data into its own buffer, so a level-triggered poll never sees readiness. Understanding fds is the prerequisite for understanding 'why doesn't poll wake up' races.
nodes.plain_zh: 每个进程一沓取号牌：几号牌是键盘、几号是屏幕、几号是管道。牌在数据没到就被人提前揣兜里了，广播（poll）自然永远叫不醒他。
nodes.plain_en: Each process holds a stack of tickets: which is the keyboard, the screen, the pipe. If someone pockets the data before the announcement (poll), the broadcast never wakes them.
nodes.example_zh: goldmine search | head 的干净退出（无 traceback）依赖对 fd 1 写入失败的显式处理。
nodes.example_en: goldmine search | head exits cleanly (no traceback) because writes to fd 1 are handled explicitly.
nodes.analogy_zh: 取号牌：0 键盘 1 屏幕 2 报错

nodes.one_liner_zh: 往没人读的管道写 = 进程收到 SIGPIPE——默认直接处死
nodes.one_liner_en: Writing a pipe nobody reads = SIGPIPE, which kills the process by default
nodes.professional_zh: 信号是操作系统戳进程的机制，SIGPIPE 专管「写进没人读的管道」——默认行为是把进程直接杀掉。goldmine search | head 中 head 先退出后，goldmine 的下一次输出就会触发它；纪律是对已关闭管道的写出吞错（BrokenPipeError 处理 + SIGPIPE ignore + 解释器收尾 flush 探针 + devnull dup2），让「下游走了」成为正常结束而不是崩溃现场（DigUp main.swift:7 同源教训）。
nodes.professional_en: Signals are the OS poking processes; SIGPIPE specifically means 'you wrote a pipe nobody reads' — default action: summary execution. After `goldmine search | head` exits, head's departure makes goldmine's next write trigger it. The discipline: swallow writes to closed pipes (BrokenPipeError handling + SIGPIPE ignore + an interpreter-teardown flush probe + devnull dup2), turning 'downstream left' into a normal exit instead of a crash scene (DigUp main.swift:7, same lesson).
nodes.plain_zh: 对着挂断的电话喊话，按默认规则你会被「处决」。goldmine 学会了先看一眼对方还在不在，不在就安静收工。
nodes.plain_en: Shouting into a hung-up phone gets you executed by default. goldmine learned to check if the line's dead and end its shift quietly.
nodes.example_zh: ANCHORS 之外的最简现场：goldmine search 常见词 | head -1 → 退出码干净、无 traceback。
nodes.example_en: Simplest live check: goldmine search <common> | head -1 → clean exit code, no traceback.
code_refs: goldmine/cli.py — BrokenPipe 处理与收尾探针

nodes.one_liner_zh: 两个执行流抢同一份数据，结果取决于时序——最阴的 bug 族
nodes.one_liner_en: Two execution streams racing one dataset; the outcome depends on timing — the sneakiest bug family
nodes.professional_zh: 真实案例：早期媒体边车给 stdout 和 stderr 各开一个排空线程，stderr 线程偶尔把协议响应抢先读走——请求永远等不到回包，且是否复现取决于毫秒级时序。四条边车纪律里至少三条是竞态的化石。通用防御：明确每条信道的唯一属主（stdout 归协议、stderr 归排空）、用裸 fd 消灭隐藏缓冲、坏输入丢弃不放大。
nodes.professional_en: The live case: early on, the media sidecar ran one drain thread each for stdout and stderr, and the stderr thread would occasionally race ahead and swallow a protocol response — requests waited forever, reproducibility riding on millisecond timing. At least three of the four sidecar rules are race-condition fossils. Generic defenses: one unique owner per channel (stdout = protocol, stderr = drain), raw fds to kill hidden buffering, drop bad input instead of amplifying it.
nodes.plain_zh: 俩人同时守一个信箱，谁先拆信看运气——有时信就被读错了。解法是规矩：一个信箱只许一个人管。
nodes.plain_en: Two people watching one mailbox: who opens the letter is luck, and sometimes it's opened wrong. The fix is a rule: one mailbox, one owner.

nodes.one_liner_zh: p95 是 95% 的样本不慢于它——尾部比平均值诚实
nodes.professional_zh: 把样本从小到大排，第 95 位取 p95。时延用分位数不用平均值，因为用户感受到的是尾部（那次 36.5 秒的查询），不是 200 次快查询的平均。对比报告同时报中位与 p95：中位是典型体验，p95 是糟糕体验的上界承诺。QMD query 臂 p95 36.5s vs goldmine 1.7s 的差距主要就在尾部。
nodes.professional_en: Sort samples and take the 95th: that's p95. Latency reports percentiles, not averages, because users experience the tail — that one 36.5-second query — not the mean of 200 fast ones. Comparison reports show median and p95 together: median is the typical experience, p95 is a bound on the bad one. The QMD query arm's p95 36.5s vs goldmine's 1.7s gap lives mostly in the tail.
nodes.plain_zh: 全班平均身高说明不了最高的门框够不够用——p95 就是「95% 的人不碰头的门框高度」。
nodes.plain_en: Average height says nothing about whether the tallest fit through the door — p95 is the door height 95% clear.
